0x00_deposit_handling.highlight: Barnabas proposes: 0x00 deposits post-fork become inactive (high activation epoch) instead of burning 32 ETH
Counter-proposal (heluani/NC): simply drop 0x00 deposits at process_deposit_request; NC has draft PR (EIPs #12533)
Key concern: burning ETH should never be the default outcome for a previously valid on-chain operation

organizational.highlight: Francesco: CFI/SFI process vs. devnet sequencing is unclear across teams — needs explicit clarification
Proposal to extend ACDT to 90 minutes going forward; end early when agenda is light
